Load NBA player-impact ratings (RAPM / SPM / BPM / DARKO) from the data repo

Source: R/load_models.R
load_mbb_player_value.Rd

Loads season-level NBA player-impact ratings – one row per player-team-season, combining regularized adjusted plus-minus (RAPM), statistical plus-minus (SPM), box plus-minus (BPM), wins above replacement (WAR), and a DARKO-style skill/projection pair. Produced by the sportsdataverse-py NBA/WNBA possession-engine model program; published to the nba_player_impact release tag as csv/parquet/rds.

Loads season-level NCAA men's college basketball player-value ratings – one row per player-team-season, with a box-score-derived offensive/defensive/net box plus-minus (BPM). Coverage starts at 2006 (the earliest season with published box-score inputs of sufficient quality for the model); this tag is parquet-only, with no csv/rds sibling assets. Produced by the sportsdataverse-py NCAA MBB model program; published to the mbb_player_value release tag.

Loads season-level NCAA men's college basketball team ratings – one row per team-season, with adjusted (opponent-strength-normalized) offensive/defensive efficiency, adjusted tempo, raw efficiency, and a national rank. A KenPom-style adjusted-efficiency-margin rating. This tag is parquet-only, with no csv/rds sibling assets. Produced by the sportsdataverse-py NCAA MBB model program; published to the mbb_ratings release tag.

Usage

load_nba_player_impact(
  seasons = most_recent_nba_season(),
  ...,
  dbConnection = NULL,
  tablename = NULL
)

load_mbb_player_value(
  seasons = most_recent_mbb_season(),
  ...,
  dbConnection = NULL,
  tablename = NULL
)

load_mbb_ratings(
  seasons = most_recent_mbb_season(),
  ...,
  dbConnection = NULL,
  tablename = NULL
)

Source

The nba_player_impact release: https://github.com/sportsdataverse/sportsdataverse-data/releases/tag/nba_player_impact.

The mbb_player_value release: https://github.com/sportsdataverse/sportsdataverse-data/releases/tag/mbb_player_value.

The mbb_ratings release: https://github.com/sportsdataverse/sportsdataverse-data/releases/tag/mbb_ratings.

Arguments

seasons

A vector of 4-digit season-ending years for NCAA men's college basketball. Published coverage runs 2006 through the most recent season, with no gaps. Pass seasons = TRUE for every published season. (Min: 2006)

...

Additional arguments passed to an underlying function that writes the season data into a database.

dbConnection

A DBIConnection object, as returned by DBI::dbConnect()

tablename

The name of the data table within the database

Value

A hoopR_data tibble with one row per player-team-season.

col_nametypesdescription
player_idintegerUnique NBA Stats player identifier.
player_namecharacterPlayer display name.
team_idintegerUnique team identifier.

team_namecharacterFull team display name.
teamscharacterTeam abbreviation(s) the player appeared for this season.
seasonintegerSeason identifier (4-digit year).
season_typecharacterSeason portion (e.g. 'Regular Season').
o_rapmnumericOffensive regularized adjusted plus-minus.
d_rapmnumericDefensive regularized adjusted plus-minus.
rapmnumericNet regularized adjusted plus-minus (o_rapm + d_rapm).
off_possintegerOffensive possessions used in the RAPM fit.
def_possintegerDefensive possessions used in the RAPM fit.
o_adj_rapmnumericOffensive RAPM adjusted for minutes/possession stability.
d_adj_rapmnumericDefensive RAPM adjusted for minutes/possession stability.
adj_rapmnumericNet adjusted RAPM (o_adj_rapm + d_adj_rapm).
ospmnumericOffensive statistical plus-minus (box-score component).
dspmnumericDefensive statistical plus-minus (box-score component).
spmnumericNet statistical plus-minus.
minnumericMinutes played.
gpintegerGames played.
obpmnumericOffensive box plus-minus.
dbpmnumericDefensive box plus-minus.
bpmnumericNet box plus-minus.
warnumericWins above replacement.
boban_filtered_skillnumericBOBAN Kalman-filtered skill estimate at the end of the player's observed multi-season RAPM panel, i.e. his current-form rating after aging drift and possession-weighted observation noise.
boban_projected_ratingnumericOne-season-ahead BOBAN forecast, the filtered skill plus the empirical aging-curve drift at the player's last observed age; both season_type rows of a player-season carry the same value because the projection is not playoff-specific.
boban_projected_sdnumericStandard deviation of the one-season-ahead BOBAN forecast, the square root of the filtered state variance plus the Kalman process variance; it sits at roughly 10.19 for a player with only one season in the panel, whose diffuse prior variance was never updated.
o_rapm_nintegerPossessions o_rapm is measured over: off_poss, his offensive possessions. o_rapm_rank and o_rapm_pct are set only when it reaches 1,700, the NBA sample at which a player's on-court rating of the same side is half signal; a regularized or box rating is less noisy, so the gate is conservative.
d_rapm_nintegerPossessions d_rapm is measured over: def_poss, his defensive possessions. d_rapm_rank and d_rapm_pct are set only when it reaches 1,600, the NBA sample at which a player's on-court rating of the same side is half signal; a regularized or box rating is less noisy, so the gate is conservative.
rapm_nintegerPossessions rapm is measured over: off_poss + def_poss, his possessions at both ends. rapm_rank and rapm_pct are set only when it reaches 3,200, the NBA sample at which a player's on-court rating of the same side is half signal; a regularized or box rating is less noisy, so the gate is conservative.
o_adj_rapm_nintegerPossessions o_adj_rapm is measured over: off_poss, his offensive possessions. o_adj_rapm_rank and o_adj_rapm_pct are set only when it reaches 1,700, the NBA sample at which a player's on-court rating of the same side is half signal; a regularized or box rating is less noisy, so the gate is conservative.
d_adj_rapm_nintegerPossessions d_adj_rapm is measured over: def_poss, his defensive possessions. d_adj_rapm_rank and d_adj_rapm_pct are set only when it reaches 1,600, the NBA sample at which a player's on-court rating of the same side is half signal; a regularized or box rating is less noisy, so the gate is conservative.
adj_rapm_nintegerPossessions adj_rapm is measured over: off_poss + def_poss, his possessions at both ends. adj_rapm_rank and adj_rapm_pct are set only when it reaches 3,200, the NBA sample at which a player's on-court rating of the same side is half signal; a regularized or box rating is less noisy, so the gate is conservative.
ospm_nintegerPossessions ospm is measured over: off_poss, his offensive possessions. ospm_rank and ospm_pct are set only when it reaches 1,700, the NBA sample at which a player's on-court rating of the same side is half signal; a regularized or box rating is less noisy, so the gate is conservative.
dspm_nintegerPossessions dspm is measured over: def_poss, his defensive possessions. dspm_rank and dspm_pct are set only when it reaches 1,600, the NBA sample at which a player's on-court rating of the same side is half signal; a regularized or box rating is less noisy, so the gate is conservative.
spm_nintegerPossessions spm is measured over: off_poss + def_poss, his possessions at both ends. spm_rank and spm_pct are set only when it reaches 3,200, the NBA sample at which a player's on-court rating of the same side is half signal; a regularized or box rating is less noisy, so the gate is conservative.
obpm_nintegerPossessions obpm is measured over: off_poss, his offensive possessions. obpm_rank and obpm_pct are set only when it reaches 1,700, the NBA sample at which a player's on-court rating of the same side is half signal; a regularized or box rating is less noisy, so the gate is conservative.
dbpm_nintegerPossessions dbpm is measured over: def_poss, his defensive possessions. dbpm_rank and dbpm_pct are set only when it reaches 1,600, the NBA sample at which a player's on-court rating of the same side is half signal; a regularized or box rating is less noisy, so the gate is conservative.
bpm_nintegerPossessions bpm is measured over: off_poss + def_poss, his possessions at both ends. bpm_rank and bpm_pct are set only when it reaches 3,200, the NBA sample at which a player's on-court rating of the same side is half signal; a regularized or box rating is less noisy, so the gate is conservative.
war_nintegerPossessions behind war: off_poss + def_poss. war is a count, not a rate, so its rank has no sample gate.
boban_filtered_skill_nintegerPossessions behind boban_filtered_skill: off_poss + def_poss, this season's possessions at both ends. The boban filtered skill is a multi-season Kalman estimate with no single-side sample, so it takes the net on-court gate, the closest existing one: boban_filtered_skill_rank and boban_filtered_skill_pct are set only when this reaches 3,200. Conservative, since the filter also carries earlier seasons.
boban_projected_rating_nintegerPossessions behind boban_projected_rating: off_poss + def_poss, this season's possessions at both ends. The boban next-season projection is a multi-season Kalman estimate with no single-side sample, so it takes the net on-court gate, the closest existing one: boban_projected_rating_rank and boban_projected_rating_pct are set only when this reaches 3,200. Conservative, since the filter also carries earlier seasons.
boban_projected_sd_nintegerPossessions behind boban_projected_sd: off_poss + def_poss, this season's possessions at both ends. The boban projection's standard deviation is a multi-season Kalman estimate with no single-side sample, so it takes the net on-court gate, the closest existing one: boban_projected_sd_rank and boban_projected_sd_pct are set only when this reaches 3,200. Conservative, since the filter also carries earlier seasons.
o_rapm_ranknumericRank of o_rapm among the season and season type's ranked players, 1 = best (higher is better), ties averaged; NA when o_rapm_n is under 1,700, and NA when its season or season_type is NA, in a group of fewer than 10 ranked players, or when every ranked value in the group is equal. Regular-season gates: a playoff run rarely reaches one.
d_rapm_ranknumericRank of d_rapm among the season and season type's ranked players, 1 = best (higher is better), ties averaged; NA when d_rapm_n is under 1,600, and NA when its season or season_type is NA, in a group of fewer than 10 ranked players, or when every ranked value in the group is equal. Regular-season gates: a playoff run rarely reaches one.

Regular-season gates: a playoff run rarely reaches one.
dbpm_ranknumericRank of dbpm among the season and season type's ranked players, 1 = best (higher is better), ties averaged; NA when dbpm_n is under 1,600, and NA when its season or season_type is NA, in a group of fewer than 10 ranked players, or when every ranked value in the group is equal. Regular-season gates: a playoff run rarely reaches one.
bpm_ranknumericRank of bpm among the season and season type's ranked players, 1 = best (higher is better), ties averaged; NA when bpm_n is under 3,200, and NA when its season or season_type is NA, in a group of fewer than 10 ranked players, or when every ranked value in the group is equal. Regular-season gates: a playoff run rarely reaches one.
war_ranknumericRank of war among the season and season type's ranked players, 1 = best (higher is better), ties averaged; ungated (every player with a finite war qualifies), NA when its season or season_type is NA, in a group of fewer than 10 ranked players, or when every ranked value in the group is equal.
boban_filtered_skill_ranknumericRank of boban_filtered_skill among the season and season type's ranked players, 1 = best (higher is better), ties averaged; NA when boban_filtered_skill_n is under 3,200, when season or season_type is NA, in a group of fewer than 10 ranked players, or when every ranked value is equal.
boban_projected_rating_ranknumericRank of boban_projected_rating among the season and season type's ranked players, 1 = best (higher is better), ties averaged; NA when boban_projected_rating_n is under 3,200, when season or season_type is NA, in a group of fewer than 10 ranked players, or when every ranked value is equal.
boban_projected_sd_ranknumericRank of boban_projected_sd among the season and season type's ranked players, ASCENDING: 1 = the smallest sd, the most certain projection; ties averaged; NA when boban_projected_sd_n is under 3,200, when season or season_type is NA, in a group of fewer than 10 ranked players, or when every ranked value is equal.
o_rapm_pctnumericPercentile of o_rapm_rank, 100 * (n + 1 - rank) / (n + 1) over the n ranked players of the season and season type; NA where the rank is.
d_rapm_pctnumericPercentile of d_rapm_rank, 100 * (n + 1 - rank) / (n + 1) over the n ranked players of the season and season type; NA where the rank is.

war_pctnumericPercentile of war_rank, 100 * (n + 1 - rank) / (n + 1) over the n ranked players of the season and season type; NA where the rank is.
boban_filtered_skill_pctnumericPercentile of boban_filtered_skill_rank, 100 * (n + 1 - rank) / (n + 1) over the n ranked players of the season and season type; NA where the rank is.
boban_projected_rating_pctnumericPercentile of boban_projected_rating_rank, 100 * (n + 1 - rank) / (n + 1) over the n ranked players of the season and season type; NA where the rank is.
boban_projected_sd_pctnumericPercentile of boban_projected_sd_rank, 100 * (n + 1 - rank) / (n + 1): high means a more certain projection (a smaller sd), not a larger one; NA where the rank is.
o_box_priornumericThe offensive prior the rating shrank toward (per 100).
d_box_priornumericThe defensive prior the rating shrank toward (per 100, positive = good defense).
box_priornumerico_box_prior + d_box_prior.
o_reml_rapmnumericOffensive season impact per 100: the posterior mean of RAPM shrunk toward the prior.
d_reml_rapmnumericDefensive season impact per 100 (positive = good defense).
reml_rapmnumerico_reml_rapm + d_reml_rapm.

A hoopR_data tibble with one row per player-team-season.

col_nametypesdescription
player_idcharacterstats.ncaa.org player identifier.
playercharacterPlayer display name (title-cased).
seasonintegerSeason identifier (4-digit season-ending year).
team_idcharacterUnique team identifier.
minnumericMinutes played.
box_obpmnumericBox-score offensive box plus-minus.
box_dbpmnumericBox-score defensive box plus-minus.
box_bpmnumericBox-score net box plus-minus (box_obpm + box_dbpm).
qualifiedlogicalTRUE when the player logged at least 300 minutes for the team that season; filter on it before ranking or comparing box_bpm values.

A hoopR_data tibble with one row per team-season.

col_nametypesdescription
seasonintegerSeason identifier (4-digit season-ending year).
team_idcharacterUnique team identifier.
adj_onumericAdjusted offensive efficiency (points per 100 possessions, opponent-adjusted).
adj_dnumericAdjusted defensive efficiency (points allowed per 100 possessions, opponent-adjusted).
adj_emnumericAdjusted efficiency margin (adj_o minus adj_d).
adj_temponumericAdjusted possessions per 40 minutes.
raw_onumericUnadjusted (raw) offensive efficiency.
raw_dnumericUnadjusted (raw) defensive efficiency.
gamesintegerGames played (season total).
rankintegerNational rank by adj_em.
adj_em_znumericZ-score of adj_em relative to the season's team distribution.
adj_o_blendnumericadj_o blended with the team's prior-season rating over the first prior_games games.
adj_d_blendnumericadj_d blended with the team's prior-season rating over the first prior_games games.
adj_em_blendnumericadj_o_blend - adj_d_blend.
rank_blendintegerRank of adj_em_blend within the season (1 = best).
prior_gamesnumericGames' worth of weight the prior-season rating carries in the blend.
